Easy Mandala Coloring Pages

Big shapes and thick lines for kids, beginners and relaxed coloring. Print at Letter or A4, or open one in the maker to change it.

  • Easy Teardrop Mandala 0112-fold, about 110 spaces
  • Easy Dot Mandala 028-fold, about 60 spaces
  • Easy Teardrop Mandala 038-fold, about 40 spaces
  • Easy Teardrop Mandala 0412-fold, about 110 spaces
  • Easy Leaf Mandala 0512-fold, about 90 spaces
  • Easy Dot Mandala 068-fold, about 70 spaces
  • Easy Leaf Mandala 078-fold, about 50 spaces
  • Easy Heart Mandala 0810-fold, about 60 spaces

About these pages

Easy pages have a few rings of big, simple shapes drawn with thick lines, so every space is roomy enough for crayons and chunky markers. They suit young kids, beginners and anyone who wants a short, relaxing page. These 8 pages have 8- to 12-fold symmetry, 4 to 6 rings of shapes, and about 40 to 110 spaces to color.

Tips for coloring them

  • Crayons and washable markers both work. Print on heavier paper if you use markers.
  • Pick two or three colors and repeat them ring by ring for a bold, tidy look.
  • Coloring with a group? Print a few different pages, or open one in the maker and press Surprise me for a new design each.
